title: VC Optimizer
features: This script removes all game sounds and eliminates lag, allowing you to use the VC without it freezing. You can use it if you're going to add music using the VC to avoid interruptions.
script:
-- Script to mute sounds and improve audio performance 
local sounds = game:GetDescendants()

for _, object in pairs(sounds) do
    if object:IsA("Sound") then
        object.Volume = 0
        object:Stop()
    end
end

-- Listen for new sounds that appear and silence them. 
game.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object)
    if object:IsA("Sound") then
        object.Volume = 0
        object:Stop()
    end
end)
